sentences.text: This first bail application has been filed by applicant under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.489/2023 registered at Police Station Sabalgarh, District Morena for offence punishable under Sections 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 376(D), 328 and 506 of IPC.
The applicant is in judicial custody since 25/09/2023.
As per the case of prosecution, father of the prosecutrix reported to PS Sabalgarh, District Morena that his daughter aged 22 years is missing since 2 PM on 20/06/2023.
PS Sabalgarh registered Missing Person Report No.20/2023.
During inquiry into this Missing Person Report, prosecutrix was recovered from house in Khoda Colony, Gaziabad.
On 24.09.2023, in her statement, prosecutrix alleged that she was working at Online Besties Company since July, 2022.
Applicant-Akshay was also working at same company.
She left the job.
Akshay had promised her another job, meanwhile,
her parents fixed her marriage on 23.06.2023.

Two days before her marriage, Varsha Sharma called Akshay Kumar Sahani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128051254/
1 her and said that she may come to Morena with documents, she will get the job, therefore, she left her parental home on 20.06.2023 and reached Morena.

sentences.text: Accused-Akshay gave her water.
After consuming water, she lost her conscious.
Akshay took her to a place which is not known to her, she was kept in a room for almost three months.
Akshay threatened and committed rape on her.
Vishal also committed rape on her.
Her parents came along with Police on 24.09.2023, thereafter, she was brought to Sabalgarh.
On such allegations, PS Sabalgarh registered FIR at Crime No.489/2023 for offence punishable under Sections 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 376(D), 328 and 506 of IPC.
The victim was forwarded for medico legal examination.
Statement of victim was recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of CrPC.
Applicant Akshay was arrested on 25.09.2023, he is in custody ever since.
Investigation is underway.
Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the prosecutrix is aged 22 years and applicant is aged 23 years.
It is a case of romantic consensual relationship between two young person.
Both of them had married and executed marriage agreement dated 22.06.2023.
The victim left her parental home at her own and came to reside with the applicant.
Later, she was taken back.
Applicant is falsely implicated in the alleged offence under pressure of her parents.
Applicant is taxi drive by profession.
There is no likelihood of his absconding leaving behind his home and profession.

Statement of witnesses have been recorded,
therefore, there is no likelihood of interfering with the investigation or tampering with the evidence.
No criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
Trial would take time to conclude.
Jail incarceration is causing hardship to the young applicant.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State oppose the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence and prays for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
